purpose: Pinned deployment configuration for the edge tool-routing service. Every supported profile uses the same v2.1 Qwen2.5-0.5B GGUF artifact and emits positional tool IDs.

public_response.mapping: The gateway maps a valid positional ID to the corresponding submitted tool name. It maps '-' or a malformed output to 'none'.

cpu.validation_notice: Raspberry Pi and Jetson CPU use this same pinned model by design, but each still requires its own target-device test_anchor validation before release.

jetson_gpu.validation_notice: This profile must be benchmarked on the target Jetson and built against its exact JetPack/L4T and CUDA compatibility before release.

unsupported_profiles.mac_gpu: Apple GPU/MPS/Metal is intentionally unsupported because Docker on macOS cannot expose the native Metal runtime.
